sentences.fr: Bonjour, je m’appelle Nora.
sentences.en: Hello, my name is Nora.
sentences.note: S’appeler supplies the naming expression.

sentences.fr: J’habite à Boston.
sentences.en: I live in Boston.
sentences.note: Use à with a city in this construction.

sentences.fr: Vous parlez anglais ?
sentences.en: Do you speak English?
sentences.note: A statement can become a conversational question through intonation.

sentences.fr: Je ne comprends pas.
sentences.en: I do not understand.
sentences.note: Ne and pas frame the finite verb.

sentences.fr: Vous pouvez répéter, s’il vous plaît ?
sentences.en: Can you repeat, please?
sentences.note: Vous is appropriate for polite singular or plural address.

sentences.fr: Nous sommes ici.
sentences.en: We are here.
sentences.note: Nous takes sommes.

sentences.fr: J’ai vingt ans.
sentences.en: I am twenty years old.
sentences.note: French uses avoir for age.

sentences.fr: Il y a un livre sur la table.
sentences.en: There is a book on the table.
sentences.note: Il y a presents an existing object.

sentences.fr: Où est la gare ?
sentences.en: Where is the station?
sentences.note: Où has an accent and asks about place.

sentences.fr: C’est une petite maison.
sentences.en: It is a small house.
sentences.note: Maison is feminine; petite agrees.

sentences.fr: Je suis à Paris aujourd’hui.
sentences.en: I am in Paris today.
sentences.note: Être expresses location here.

sentences.fr: J’apprends le français.
sentences.en: I am learning French.
sentences.note: The language follows apprendre with the definite article here.

sentences.fr: Je parle un peu français.
sentences.en: I speak a little French.
sentences.note: Un peu expresses a small amount.

sentences.fr: Elle est ici pour une semaine.
sentences.en: She is here for a week.
sentences.note: Pour gives the intended length of the stay here.

sentences.fr: C’est intéressant, mais ce n’est pas facile.
sentences.en: It is interesting, but it is not easy.
sentences.note: Mais connects contrasting evaluations.

sentences.fr: J’ai un rendez-vous lundi.
sentences.en: I have an appointment on Monday.
sentences.note: Lundi without an article identifies a particular Monday in context.

sentences.fr: J’ai froid.
sentences.en: I am cold.
sentences.note: Avoir froid is a fixed expression.

sentences.fr: Vous êtes ici ?
sentences.en: Are you here?
sentences.note: Vous requires êtes.

sentences.fr: Comment ça s’écrit ?
sentences.en: How is that written?
sentences.note: Learn this useful repair phrase as a whole.

sentences.fr: Merci pour votre aide.
sentences.en: Thank you for your help.
sentences.note: Pour introduces what you are thanking someone for.

grammar.prompt: Je ___ Nora.
grammar.explanation: Je takes suis, the first-person present of être.

grammar.prompt: Vous ___ ici.
grammar.explanation: Vous takes êtes.

grammar.prompt: I am twenty years old: J’___ vingt ans.
grammar.explanation: Age uses avoir: j’ai vingt ans.

grammar.prompt: Choose the article for table.

grammar.prompt: Choose a correct negative.
grammar.explanation: Ne and pas surround the finite verb suis.

grammar.prompt: Nous ___ à Paris.

grammar.prompt: There is a book: ___ un livre.

grammar.prompt: Where is the station? ___ est la gare ?
grammar.explanation: Où with a grave accent means where; ou means or.

grammar.prompt: A small house: une ___ maison.
grammar.explanation: Maison is feminine singular, so petite agrees.

grammar.prompt: I am cold: J’___ froid.
grammar.explanation: French uses avoir froid.

grammar.prompt: Polite speech to an unfamiliar adult: ___ parlez anglais ?
grammar.explanation: Vous is a useful polite opening to an unfamiliar adult.

grammar.prompt: Choose the ordinary written form.
grammar.explanation: Je elides before the vowel in ai.

grammar.prompt: In les amis, a common liaison sound is ___.
grammar.explanation: The plural article commonly links with /z/ before amis.

grammar.prompt: Which phrase means I need help?
grammar.explanation: Avoir besoin de is the construction; de elides before aide.

grammar.prompt: The plural of le livre is ___.
grammar.explanation: Use plural article les and plural spelling livres.

sentences.fr: Ma sœur habite près de la gare.
sentences.en: My sister lives near the station.
sentences.note: Ma agrees with sœur; près de introduces the location.

sentences.fr: Nous n'avons pas de voiture.
sentences.en: We do not have a car.
sentences.note: An indefinite possession becomes de in this ordinary negative.

sentences.fr: À quelle heure est-ce que le magasin ouvre ?
sentences.en: What time does the shop open?
alternativesFr: Le magasin ouvre à quelle heure ?
À quelle heure ouvre le magasin ?
sentences.note: Quelle agrees with heure; est-ce que retains statement word order.

sentences.fr: Ces maisons sont anciennes.
sentences.en: These houses are old.
sentences.note: Anciennes agrees with feminine plural maisons.

sentences.fr: J'ai vingt-cinq ans et je travaille dans une librairie.
sentences.en: I am twenty-five and I work in a bookshop.
sentences.note: Age uses avoir; librairie means bookshop.

sentences.fr: Nous nous levons à sept heures le lundi.
sentences.en: We get up at seven on Mondays.
sentences.note: The first nous is subject; the second is reflexive. Le lundi marks a habit.

sentences.fr: Vous pouvez répéter plus lentement ?
sentences.en: Can you repeat more slowly?
alternativesFr: Est-ce que vous pouvez répéter plus lentement ?
sentences.note: Pouvez is conjugated; répéter remains an infinitive.

sentences.fr: J'aime les chiens, mais je n'aime pas ce chien.
sentences.en: I like dogs, but I do not like this dog.
sentences.note: Generic preference uses the definite article; ce points to one dog.

sentences.fr: Son amie est française.
sentences.en: Her friend is French.
sentences.note: Son precedes a feminine vowel-initial noun; française still agrees with amie.

sentences.fr: Vous êtes libre jeudi après-midi ?
sentences.en: Are you free on Thursday afternoon?
alternativesFr: Est-ce que vous êtes libre jeudi après-midi ?
sentences.note: This model addresses one person politely; a plural addressee requires libres.

sentences.fr: Je connais cette rue.
sentences.en: I know this street.
sentences.note: Connaître expresses familiarity with a place.

sentences.fr: Elle ne travaille plus ici.
sentences.en: She no longer works here.
sentences.note: Ne…plus means no longer in this context.

sentences.fr: Il y a une pharmacie dans ce quartier.
sentences.en: There is a pharmacy in this neighborhood.
sentences.note: Il y a introduces existence and does not agree with the following noun.

sentences.fr: Mon frère a faim.
sentences.en: My brother is hungry.
sentences.note: The idiom avoir faim uses avoir rather than être.

sentences.fr: Nous allons au marché le samedi.
sentences.en: We go to the market on Saturdays.
sentences.note: À plus le contracts to au; le samedi expresses a repeated day.

sentences.fr: Je ne comprends pas la question.
sentences.en: I do not understand the question.
sentences.note: Negation surrounds the conjugated verb; the definite article remains.

sentences.fr: Cet appartement est petit mais confortable.
sentences.en: This apartment is small but comfortable.
sentences.note: Cet precedes the vowel-initial masculine noun appartement.

sentences.fr: Tu sais nager ?
sentences.en: Do you know how to swim?
sentences.note: Savoir plus infinitive expresses a learned skill.

sentences.fr: Ma collègue parle français et anglais.
sentences.en: My colleague speaks French and English.
sentences.note: Language names after parler do not agree with the speaker.

sentences.fr: Je vais me coucher à dix heures.
sentences.en: I am going to go to bed at ten.
sentences.note: The reflexive pronoun belongs to the infinitive coucher.

grammar.prompt: J'aime ___ café. (coffee in general)

grammar.prompt: Nous ___ français.

grammar.prompt: Elle ___ vingt ans.

grammar.prompt: Je n'ai pas ___ voiture. (I do not have a car; ordinary indefinite possession)
grammar.explanation: The ordinary negative of an indefinite possession uses de.

grammar.prompt: ___ appartement est calme. (this)
grammar.explanation: Appartement is masculine and begins with a vowel sound, so use cet.

grammar.prompt: Ces maisons sont ___.
grammar.explanation: The adjective agrees with feminine plural maisons.

grammar.prompt: Nous ___ levons à sept heures.
grammar.explanation: The reflexive pronoun agrees with the subject nous.

grammar.prompt: Je peux ___ demain.
grammar.explanation: After peux, the second verb is an infinitive.

grammar.prompt: Nous allons ___ marché.
grammar.explanation: À plus the masculine singular definite article le contracts to au.

grammar.prompt: Je ___ cette personne. (am familiar with)
grammar.explanation: Connaître is used for familiarity with a person.

grammar.prompt: Quelle phrase pose une question neutre ?
grammar.explanation: Est-ce que is followed by statement word order.

grammar.prompt: Vous n'habitez pas ici ? — ___, j'habite ici.
grammar.explanation: Si contradicts the negative assumption.

grammar.prompt: Je ___ pas la question.
grammar.explanation: Ne precedes and pas follows the conjugated verb.

grammar.prompt: ___ amie est patiente. (his)

sentences.fr: Hier, j'ai acheté deux billets.
sentences.en: Yesterday, I bought two tickets.
sentences.note: The completed purchase uses avoir plus acheté.

sentences.fr: Ma sœur est arrivée à neuf heures.
sentences.en: My sister arrived at nine.
sentences.note: Arriver takes être here and arrivée agrees with the feminine subject.

sentences.fr: Nous n'avons pas trouvé la gare.
sentences.en: We did not find the station.
sentences.note: Negation surrounds the auxiliary; the definite article remains.

sentences.fr: Demain, nous allons louer des vélos.
sentences.en: Tomorrow, we are going to rent bicycles.
sentences.note: Allons is conjugated and louer remains an infinitive.

sentences.fr: Quand tu arriveras, je t'appellerai.
sentences.en: When you arrive, I will call you.
sentences.note: A future time clause with quand uses future in French.

sentences.fr: S'il pleut, nous prendrons le bus.
sentences.en: If it rains, we will take the bus.
sentences.note: Ordinary conditional si takes present, followed here by future in the main clause.

sentences.fr: Prenez cette rue et tournez à gauche.
sentences.en: Take this street and turn left.
sentences.note: The imperative omits the subject pronoun.

sentences.fr: N'oubliez pas votre passeport.
sentences.en: Do not forget your passport.
sentences.note: Ne and pas surround the negative imperative.

sentences.fr: Je voudrais une bouteille d'eau.
sentences.en: I would like a bottle of water.
sentences.note: A quantity container is followed by de, elided before eau.

sentences.fr: J'habite ici depuis trois mois.
sentences.en: I have lived here for three months.
sentences.note: The residence continues now, so French uses present plus depuis.

sentences.fr: Elle a sorti les clés de son sac.
sentences.en: She took the keys out of her bag.
sentences.note: Sortir takes avoir with a directly expressed object.

sentences.fr: Elle est sortie à huit heures.
sentences.en: She went out at eight.
sentences.note: Intransitive sortir takes être, with feminine agreement here.

sentences.fr: Je vais les acheter demain.
sentences.en: I am going to buy them tomorrow.
sentences.note: Les belongs to the infinitive acheter.

sentences.fr: Il n'y a plus de pain.
sentences.en: There is no bread left.
sentences.note: Ne…plus expresses no longer or no more; indefinite quantity becomes de.

sentences.fr: Vous recevrez une confirmation demain.
sentences.en: You will receive a confirmation tomorrow.
sentences.note: Recevoir has the future stem recevr-.

sentences.fr: Nous avons marché pendant une heure.
sentences.en: We walked for an hour.
sentences.note: Marcher uses avoir despite describing movement; pendant gives a completed duration.

sentences.fr: Je lui ai téléphoné ce matin.
sentences.en: I called her this morning.
sentences.note: Téléphoner à takes an indirect object; lui can mean him or her.

sentences.fr: Nous sommes allés au marché en bus.
sentences.en: We went to the market by bus.
sentences.note: Aller takes être; allés is the standard mixed-group or all-male agreement.

sentences.fr: Je ne mange pas de viande.
sentences.en: I do not eat meat.
sentences.note: The partitive becomes de in this ordinary negative.

sentences.fr: Vous pouvez payer par carte ou en espèces.
sentences.en: You can pay by card or in cash.
sentences.note: Payer remains an infinitive after pouvez; learn payment methods as chunks.

grammar.prompt: Hier, j'___ acheté un billet.
grammar.explanation: Acheter forms the passé composé with avoir.

grammar.prompt: Ma sœur est ___ hier.
grammar.explanation: An être participle agrees with the feminine singular subject.

grammar.prompt: Nous avons ___ pendant une heure.
grammar.explanation: Avoir is followed by the past participle marché.

grammar.prompt: Elle ___ sorti les clés de son sac.
grammar.explanation: Sortir with the direct object les clés takes avoir.

grammar.prompt: Demain, nous allons ___ une chambre.
grammar.explanation: The future with aller is followed by an infinitive.

grammar.prompt: Quand tu ___, je t'appellerai.
grammar.explanation: A future time clause after quand uses a future form.

grammar.prompt: Si tu ___ tôt, nous dînerons ensemble.
grammar.explanation: Ordinary future conditions use si plus present, not future.

grammar.prompt: ___ cette rue ! (vous)
grammar.explanation: The vous imperative is prenez with no expressed subject.

grammar.prompt: Je voudrais une bouteille ___ eau.
grammar.explanation: A container quantity uses de, which elides before eau.

grammar.prompt: Je ne mange pas ___ viande. (I do not eat meat; ordinary denial, without a contrast)
grammar.explanation: An ordinary negative indefinite quantity uses de.

grammar.prompt: Je vis ici ___ deux ans, et j'y vis toujours.
grammar.explanation: Depuis marks a situation continuing into the present.

grammar.prompt: Je partirai ___ deux heures. (from now)
grammar.explanation: Dans locates an event after a future interval.

grammar.prompt: Je téléphone à ma sœur. Je ___ téléphone.
grammar.explanation: Téléphoner à requires an indirect-object pronoun.

grammar.prompt: Je vais acheter les billets. Je vais ___ acheter.
grammar.explanation: Les replaces the definite direct object and goes with acheter.

grammar.prompt: Le trajet ___ vingt euros demain.
grammar.explanation: The third-person singular simple future is coûtera.

sentences.fr: Je préparais le dîner quand tu as appelé.
sentences.en: I was preparing dinner when you called.
sentences.note: The ongoing preparation is background; the call is a bounded event.

sentences.fr: Quand je suis arrivé, elles étaient déjà parties.
sentences.en: When I arrived, they had already left.
sentences.note: The plus-que-parfait places their departure before the past arrival; the group is feminine.

sentences.fr: Je les lui ai données hier.
sentences.en: I gave them to her yesterday.
alternativesEn: I gave them to him yesterday.
sentences.note: In this context les refers to les clés; direct les precedes indirect lui and triggers données.

sentences.fr: Tu as trois billets ? Oui, j'en ai trois.
sentences.en: Do you have three tickets? Yes, I have three.
sentences.note: En replaces the counted noun while trois remains.

sentences.fr: Le document que vous avez envoyé est utile.
sentences.en: The document that you sent is useful.
sentences.note: Que is the direct object of avez envoyé in the relative clause.

sentences.fr: C'est la ville où j'ai grandi.
sentences.en: This is the town where I grew up.
sentences.note: Où introduces a relative referring to location.

sentences.fr: Le dossier dont je parle est sur la table.
sentences.en: The file I am talking about is on the table.
sentences.note: Parler de creates the de-relationship replaced by dont.

sentences.fr: Cette solution est meilleure, mais elle coûte plus cher.
sentences.en: This solution is better, but it costs more.
sentences.note: Meilleure modifies feminine solution; plus cher belongs to the cost expression.

sentences.fr: Nous y allions tous les étés.
sentences.en: We used to go there every summer.
sentences.note: Imparfait presents a past routine; y replaces the destination.

sentences.fr: Ne me le donnez pas maintenant.
sentences.en: Do not give it to me now.
sentences.note: The negative imperative uses ordinary pre-verbal pronoun order.

sentences.fr: J'avais oublié mon billet à la maison.
sentences.en: I had forgotten my ticket at home.
sentences.note: The earlier forgetting is located before an understood past reference point.

sentences.fr: Je lui en ai parlé.
sentences.en: I spoke to her about it.
alternativesEn: I spoke to him about it.
I have spoken to her about it.
I have spoken to him about it.
sentences.note: Lui replaces the addressee; en replaces the topic introduced by de.

sentences.fr: Les lettres que j'ai écrites sont sur le bureau.
sentences.en: The letters I wrote are on the desk.
alternativesEn: The letters I have written are on the desk.
sentences.note: Que refers to feminine plural lettres and precedes the avoir participle.

sentences.fr: Il travaillait quand nous sommes entrés.
sentences.en: He was working when we came in.
sentences.note: Working is background to the completed entrance.

sentences.fr: Cette chambre est moins chère que l'autre.
sentences.en: This room is cheaper than the other.
sentences.note: Moins chère que literally means less expensive than; chère agrees with chambre.

sentences.fr: Elles se sont lavé les mains.
sentences.en: They washed their hands.
sentences.note: Les mains is the following direct object; se is indirect, so lavé does not agree.

sentences.fr: Je vous envoie le document en pièce jointe.
sentences.en: I am sending you the document as an attachment.
sentences.note: Vous is the indirect recipient; en pièce jointe is a fixed administrative phrase.

sentences.fr: La circulation était lente parce qu'il pleuvait.
sentences.en: The traffic was slow because it was raining.
sentences.note: Both clauses describe the background situation.

sentences.fr: J'ai autant de travail que toi.
sentences.en: I have as much work as you.
sentences.note: A comparison of noun quantities uses autant de…que.

sentences.fr: La conseillère m'a indiqué les pièces dont j'avais besoin.
sentences.en: The adviser told me which documents I needed.
sentences.note: Avoir besoin de supplies the de-relationship for dont; avait besoin becomes avais besoin with je.

grammar.prompt: À cette époque, nous ___ à Lyon. (habitual background)
grammar.explanation: The imparfait presents the past residence as background.

grammar.prompt: Je préparais le dîner quand tu ___ appelé. (You called; the call is a bounded event.)
grammar.explanation: A bounded call interrupting an ongoing background is naturally expressed in passé composé.

grammar.prompt: Quand je suis arrivé, elle ___ déjà partie.
grammar.explanation: The earlier departure uses plus-que-parfait with être.

grammar.prompt: Nous étudi___ chaque soir à cette époque.
grammar.explanation: Étudier forms the imparfait nous étudiions, including two written i's.

grammar.prompt: Je téléphone à Léa. Je ___ téléphone.
grammar.explanation: Téléphoner à takes an indirect object; lui can refer to Léa.

grammar.prompt: Je pense à ce problème. J'___ pense.
grammar.explanation: Y replaces a selected à plus thing complement.

grammar.prompt: J'ai trois billets. J'___ ai trois.
grammar.explanation: En replaces the noun introduced by a quantity while three remains.

grammar.prompt: Je donne le formulaire à Léa. Je ___ donne.
grammar.explanation: Direct le precedes indirect lui before the conjugated verb.

grammar.prompt: Je vais donner le document à Léa. Je vais ___ donner.
grammar.explanation: Both pronouns belong before donner and follow the normal order le then lui.

grammar.prompt: Les clés que j'ai ___ sont ici.
grammar.explanation: The preceding direct object que refers to feminine plural clés.

grammar.prompt: Elles se sont ___ les mains.
grammar.explanation: Les mains is a following direct object; se is indirect, so lavé does not agree.

grammar.prompt: Voici le voisin ___ travaille à la mairie.
grammar.explanation: Qui is the subject of travaille inside the relative clause.

grammar.prompt: Voici le dossier ___ je parle.
grammar.explanation: Parler de requires the de-relationship expressed by dont.

grammar.prompt: Cette solution est ___ que l'autre. (Describe solution in edited standard French.)
grammar.explanation: An adjective modifying feminine solution uses meilleure.

grammar.prompt: Ne ___ donnez pas ! (it to me)
grammar.explanation: A negative imperative uses ordinary pre-verbal order me then le.

sentences.fr: Si vous confirmez aujourd'hui, nous réserverons la salle.
sentences.en: If you confirm today, we will book the room.
sentences.note: Open condition: present after conditional si, future consequence.

sentences.fr: Quand tu arriveras, je t'appellerai.
sentences.en: When you arrive, I will call you.
sentences.note: Future after quand for a future event.

sentences.fr: Si j'avais plus de temps, je suivrais cette formation.
sentences.en: If I had more time, I would take this training course.
sentences.note: Hypothetical present: imparfait and conditional.

sentences.fr: À ta place, je demanderais des précisions.
sentences.en: In your position, I would ask for details.
sentences.note: Conditional gives advice.

sentences.fr: Pourriez-vous m'envoyer le devis ?
sentences.en: Could you send me the estimate?
sentences.note: Conditional request with vous.

sentences.fr: Nous pourrions reporter la réunion à vendredi.
sentences.en: We could postpone the meeting until Friday.
sentences.note: Conditional presents an option.

sentences.fr: Tu devrais en parler à ta responsable.
sentences.en: You should discuss it with your manager.
sentences.note: En replaces the topic introduced by de.

sentences.fr: Si elle avait reçu le message, elle serait venue.
sentences.en: If she had received the message, she would have come.
sentences.note: Past counterfactual; venir takes être and venue agrees with elle.

sentences.fr: J'aurais dû vérifier l'adresse.
sentences.en: I should have checked the address.
sentences.note: Conditional past of devoir expresses regret.

sentences.fr: Si j'avais accepté ce poste, j'habiterais à Lyon maintenant.
sentences.en: If I had accepted that job, I would live in Lyon now.
sentences.note: Past condition and present consequence.

sentences.fr: Je fais réparer mon ordinateur.
sentences.en: I am having my computer repaired.
sentences.note: Faire plus infinitive expresses arranging an action.

sentences.fr: Elle laisse ses enfants choisir leurs vêtements.
sentences.en: She lets her children choose their clothes.
sentences.note: Laisser expresses permission.

sentences.fr: Il me demande de rappeler demain.
sentences.en: He asks me to call back tomorrow.
sentences.note: Demander à quelqu'un de plus infinitive reports a request.

sentences.fr: Elle nous demande de ne pas arriver en retard.
sentences.en: She asks us not to arrive late.
sentences.note: Ne pas precedes the infinitive.

sentences.fr: Je ne sais pas s'il viendra.
sentences.en: I do not know whether he will come.
sentences.note: Si means whether here, allowing the future.

sentences.fr: Léa dit qu'elle est disponible demain.
sentences.en: Léa says that she is available tomorrow.
sentences.note: Present reporting keeps the current frame.

sentences.fr: Elle a dit qu'elle viendrait mardi.
sentences.en: She said that she would come on Tuesday.
sentences.note: Conditional can be future relative to a past statement.

sentences.fr: Nous pourrons le lui envoyer demain.
sentences.en: We will be able to send it to her tomorrow.
sentences.note: Pronouns belong to envoyer and precede that infinitive.

sentences.fr: Oui, je lui en ai parlé.
sentences.en: Yes, I discussed it with her.
sentences.note: Lui replaces the person and en replaces the topic.

sentences.fr: Si vous avez un problème, appelez-moi.
sentences.en: If you have a problem, call me.
sentences.note: Open condition with an imperative consequence.

grammar.prompt: Complete an open future condition: Si tu ___ aujourd'hui, je réserverai.
grammar.explanation: Conditional si takes the present in an open future condition.

grammar.prompt: Complete a hypothetical present: Si j'avais le temps, je ___.
grammar.explanation: An imparfait condition normally takes a conditional consequence.

grammar.prompt: Choose the polite request.
grammar.explanation: Pourriez is the conditional of pouvoir; aider remains infinitive.

grammar.prompt: Complete the past counterfactual: Si elle avait su, elle ___.
grammar.explanation: The unreal past consequence takes the conditional past; venir uses être.

grammar.prompt: Choose the regret meaning I should have checked.
grammar.explanation: Conditional past of devoir expresses a missed desirable action.

grammar.prompt: Choose the future of être with nous.
grammar.explanation: Serons is future; serions is conditional.

grammar.prompt: Complete a future time clause: Quand tu ___, je partirai.
grammar.explanation: French uses the future after quand for a future event.

grammar.prompt: Choose the correct whether clause.
options: Je ne sais pas s'il viendra.
Je ne sais pas si viendra-t-il.
Je ne sais pas est-ce qu'il viendra.
Je ne sais pas s'il venir.
grammar.explanation: Indirect yes–no questions use si with statement order; future is allowed.

grammar.prompt: Choose I am having my bicycle repaired.
grammar.explanation: Faire plus infinitive expresses arranging repair by someone else.

grammar.prompt: Complete the reported request: Elle nous demande ___ attendre.
grammar.explanation: Demander à quelqu'un de plus infinitive reports a request.

grammar.prompt: Choose a negative infinitive.
grammar.explanation: Ne pas stays together before an ordinary negative infinitive.

grammar.prompt: Complete the pronouns: Je donne le dossier à Nadia. Je ___ donne.
grammar.explanation: Le precedes lui in ordinary preverbal pronoun order.

grammar.prompt: Choose the present hypothetical condition.
grammar.explanation: Ordinary hypothetical conditional si takes the imparfait, not conditional.

grammar.prompt: Choose the mixed-time consequence: Si j'avais accepté, je ___ ici maintenant.
grammar.explanation: A present imagined consequence takes the conditional present.

grammar.prompt: Complete: Je promets de ___ demain, meaning I promise to call her tomorrow.

sentences.fr: Les propositions que nous avons retenues seront présentées demain.
sentences.en: The proposals we selected will be presented tomorrow.
sentences.note: Retenues agrees with preceding direct object propositions; présentées agrees with passive subject.

sentences.fr: Elles se sont lavé les mains.
sentences.en: They washed their hands.
sentences.note: Les mains is the following direct object; se is indirect, so lavé remains invariable.

sentences.fr: Elles se sont parlé pendant une heure.
sentences.en: They talked to each other for an hour.
sentences.note: Parler à takes an indirect object, so parlé does not agree with se.

sentences.fr: Les robes qu'elle a fait refaire sont prêtes.
sentences.en: The dresses she had remade are ready.
sentences.note: Fait before an infinitive is invariable.

sentences.fr: Quand je suis arrivé à la gare, le train était déjà parti.
sentences.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left.
sentences.note: A full time clause identifies the actor clearly.

sentences.fr: Il aurait refusé de signer l'accord.
sentences.en: He reportedly refused to sign the agreement.
sentences.note: In a news-report context, conditional past can mark unconfirmed information; other contexts permit a hypothetical reading.

sentences.fr: Cela fait trois ans que je travaille ici.
sentences.en: I have been working here for three years.
sentences.note: French uses present for a continuing situation with cela fait...que.

sentences.fr: Je viens de terminer la révision.
sentences.en: I have just finished the revision.
sentences.note: Venir de plus infinitive marks recent completion.

sentences.fr: Puisque le bureau est fermé, nous reviendrons demain.
sentences.en: Since the office is closed, we will come back tomorrow.
sentences.note: Puisque presents the closure as an accepted reason.

sentences.fr: Ce chiffre doit être mis en perspective.
sentences.en: This figure needs to be put in context.
sentences.note: Mettre en perspective means to interpret in context.

sentences.fr: Si je comprends bien, vous avez des réserves sur la mise en œuvre.
sentences.en: If I understand correctly, you have reservations about implementation.
sentences.note: The phrase checks the listener's interpretation.

sentences.fr: Quand vous dites ambitieux, pensez-vous au budget ou au calendrier ?
sentences.en: When you say ambitious, are you thinking of the budget or the timeline?
sentences.note: The question clarifies an ambiguous evaluation.

sentences.fr: Je corrige : il s'agit d'une estimation, pas d'un montant définitif.
sentences.en: Let me correct that: it is an estimate, not a final amount.
sentences.note: The repair explicitly restores the claim's status.

sentences.fr: Je ne dispose pas encore d'une estimation complète.
sentences.en: I do not yet have a complete estimate.
sentences.note: Disposer de expresses having resources or information available.

sentences.fr: L'ouverture progressive serait utile, à condition que chaque étape soit évaluée.
sentences.en: Gradual opening would be useful, provided that each stage is assessed.
sentences.note: À condition que takes the subjunctive.

sentences.fr: La nouveauté attirera probablement des visiteurs occasionnels.
sentences.en: The novelty will probably attract occasional visitors.
sentences.note: Probablement qualifies a future prediction.

sentences.fr: Il faut distinguer les visites ponctuelles des usages réguliers.
sentences.en: We must distinguish occasional visits from regular use.
sentences.note: Distinguer A de B identifies the contrast.

sentences.fr: Les deux groupes soutiennent la réutilisation du bâtiment, sous certaines conditions.
sentences.en: Both groups support reusing the building, under certain conditions.
sentences.note: The qualification prevents support from becoming unconditional.

sentences.fr: Cette mesure est efficace, mais sa rentabilité reste incertaine.
sentences.en: This measure is effective, but its profitability remains uncertain.
sentences.note: Effectiveness and financial return are separate dimensions.

sentences.fr: Le fait de reconnaître une limite ne rend pas l'argument inutile.
sentences.en: Acknowledging a limitation does not make the argument useless.
sentences.note: Le fait de plus infinitive packages an action as a noun phrase.

grammar.prompt: Les mesures que nous avons ___ sont utiles.
grammar.explanation: The preceding direct object mesures is feminine plural.

grammar.prompt: Elles se sont ___ les mains.
grammar.explanation: Les mains is the following direct object; se is indirect.

grammar.prompt: Elles se sont ___ pendant une heure.
grammar.explanation: Parler à takes an indirect object; the participle is invariable here.

grammar.prompt: Les robes qu’elle a ___ refaire sont prêtes.
grammar.explanation: Fait before an infinitive is invariable.

grammar.prompt: Choose the clear sentence.
options: Quand je suis arrivé, le train était parti.
En arrivant, le train était parti.
Étant arrivé, le train était parti de moi.
Arrivé de moi, le train partait.
grammar.explanation: The time clause explicitly identifies who arrived.

grammar.prompt: In a news context, Il aurait refusé can mean...
grammar.explanation: Conditional past can present unconfirmed reported information.

grammar.prompt: I have worked here for three years: Cela fait trois ans que je ___ ici.
grammar.explanation: The continuing situation uses present in this French construction.

grammar.prompt: I have just finished: Je ___ terminer.
grammar.explanation: Venir de plus infinitive marks recent completion.

grammar.prompt: The office is closed, so we will return: ___ le bureau est fermé, nous reviendrons.
grammar.explanation: Puisque introduces an accepted reason.

grammar.prompt: A measure that achieves its aim is ___.
grammar.explanation: Efficace concerns effectiveness, not necessarily profitability.

grammar.prompt: Which verb is neutral reporting here? Le rapport ___ que la salle est libre.
grammar.explanation: Indique reports information neutrally in this context.

grammar.prompt: À condition que chaque étape ___ évaluée.
grammar.explanation: À condition que governs the subjunctive.

grammar.prompt: Il faut distinguer les visites ponctuelles ___ usages réguliers.
grammar.explanation: Distinguer A de B gives de + les = des.

grammar.prompt: Je ___ réponds demain. (to several people)
grammar.explanation: Indirect object pronoun leur is invariable.

grammar.prompt: Which form means where?
grammar.explanation: Où with accent relates to place or some time constructions; ou offers an alternative.
